Method of Attack: The package steals sensitive information from Discord apps and web browsers installed on a user’s machine and uploads them to a third-party Discord server.
Discoverer: ZDNet and analyzed by the npm security team
Attack Vector: The component when included in your development builds runs alongside your program, and accesses the listed files.
Indicators of Compromise: The webhook variable containing the URL to the attacker’s Discord app where data read from the “leveldb” files are posted.
